language.description: Show or switch the interface language. Usage: /my-memory:language [auto|{{options}}]

l1Mode.description: Switch the L1 extraction mode: code (work_fact/work_task/work_method/work_artifact) or chat (persona/episodic/instruction). Usage: /my-memory:l1-mode [code|chat]

l3Trigger.description: Manually trigger L3 persona generation (update the draft profile USER-temp.md from L2 scenes, then merge it into USER.md yourself). Usage: /my-memory:l3-trigger

profile.description: List or switch memory profiles. Usage: /my-memory:profile [list|switch <name>]

l2Trigger.description: Manually queue one L2 scene organization run. Usage: /my-memory:l2-trigger

subagentKill.description: Manually stop a layer's background subagent (for use beyond the hard limit). Usage: /my-memory:subagent-kill <l1|l2|l3> [jobId]

l2ArchiveList.description: List the L2 archive: contents and ledger (who moved what, when, and why). Usage: /my-memory:l2:archive-list

l2Archive.description: Manually move one scene block into the archive. Usage: /my-memory:l2:archive <file.md> --reason "why move it"

l2Restore.description: Move an archived block back into the scene directory. Usage: /my-memory:l2:restore <file.md>

l1Trigger.description: Manually queue one L1 extraction run (bypasses the L1_INTERVAL turn count). Usage: /my-memory:l1-trigger

embeddingList.description: Show L1 record vectorization status. Usage: /my-memory:l1:embedding:list [limit=10]

embeddingBackfill.description: Embed all un-vectorized L1 records and store them. Usage: /my-memory:l1:embedding:backfill

embeddingRebuild.description: Clear the vector store and re-embed all L1 records (fixes stale embeddings). Usage: /my-memory:l1:embedding:rebuild

l1Fix.description: Manually rewrite or tombstone one L1 memory. Usage: /my-memory:l1:fix <id> --action rewrite|tombstone --content "new content" --evidence "evidence" [--force] [--priority 80] [--reason reason]

l1Health.description: L1 store health metrics (over-long / test leftovers / orphan stats / self-made ids / malformed lines / error strings)

l1Quality.description: Rank L1 atomic memories by quality score (effective*decay*(1-min(invalid/hits,0.8)), days counted by active session days). Usage: /my-memory:l1:quality [top=20]

l1Stats.description: Summarize L1 quality distribution and the cold/noise lists. Usage: /my-memory:l1:stats
